item.title: AMD unveils Helios rack-scale AI system for Azure
item.description: AMD unveiled Helios, a rack-scale AI system combining its GPUs, CPUs, networking, and software, with Microsoft planning to deploy it in Azure data centers as AMD challenges NVIDIA's AI infrastructure stack.

item.title: Z.ai starts gigawatt-scale AI data center without NVIDIA GPUs
item.description: Z.ai reportedly began partial operations at a one-gigawatt AI data center powered by Chinese-made chips, expanding compute for GLM models while reducing reliance on NVIDIA hardware.

item.title: Google reportedly designs Gemini-specific AI chip
item.description: Google is reportedly developing an AI chip with Gemini's neural architecture baked into silicon, trading generality for lower inference overhead and a tighter model-hardware stack.

item.title: Moonshot launches Kimi Work desktop agent
item.description: Moonshot AI launched Kimi Work, a Windows and macOS desktop agent that can connect to local files, coordinate specialized agents, and automate document and spreadsheet workflows in the background.

item.title: Alibaba announces 2.4T-parameter Qwen3.8 model
item.description: Alibaba announced Qwen3.8, a 2.4-trillion-parameter model now in preview through its Token Plan and Qoder products, with an open-weight release planned.

item.title: Meta and Anthropic reportedly discuss $10B compute deal
item.description: Meta reportedly discussed leasing computing power to Anthropic in a deal worth up to $10 billion over two years, underscoring continuing frontier-lab demand for scarce AI compute.

item.title: SpaceX reportedly in talks to supply Pentagon AI compute
item.description: SpaceX is reportedly in talks to provide the U.S. Defense Department with AI computing capacity worth up to several billion dollars as the Pentagon pursues high-end chips.

item.title: Alibaba open-sources AI chip software stack to challenge CUDA lock-in
item.description: Alibaba open-sourced its SAIL software stack for AI chips, aiming to lower migration barriers for developers currently tied to NVIDIA's CUDA ecosystem.

item.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 long-context model
item.description: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3, a model with a one-million-token context window, faster long-context decoding, and optimizations for agentic coding, with open weights scheduled.

item.title: Google Gemini 3.5 Pro reportedly delayed
item.description: Google reportedly delayed Gemini 3.5 Pro after the model fell short of internal goals, particularly in coding, while it remains in partner testing alongside other Gemini releases.

item.title: Fireworks reportedly reaches $17.5B valuation
item.description: Nvidia-backed Fireworks reportedly reached a $17.5 billion valuation as enterprises seek cheaper model-serving options and open-model infrastructure.

item.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3 embedding models
item.description: NVIDIA released three open Nemotron 3 embedding models for RAG, agentic retrieval, code search, and memory, led by an 8B model ranking highly on retrieval benchmarks.

item.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling open model
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling, its first open model, a multimodal mixture-of-experts system with a one-million-token context window and customization through Tinker.

item.title: Anthropic reportedly prepares investor meetings for mega-IPO
item.description: Anthropic is reportedly lining up investor meetings for a potential IPO after a funding round that valued the AI lab near $965 billion, testing public-market appetite for frontier labs.

item.title: OpenAI trains GPT-Red to automate model red-teaming
item.description: OpenAI trained GPT-Red to generate adversarial prompts and surface model vulnerabilities at scale, reporting reduced failures when its attacks were folded back into training.

item.title: Perplexity launches secure sandboxes for AI agents
item.description: Perplexity introduced SPACE, a sandbox platform meant to run AI agents on sensitive tasks with stronger isolation, security, and operational controls.

item.title: China tightens rules on companion chatbots
item.description: China introduced rules forbidding companion chatbots from encouraging emotional dependence or relationships with minors, and requiring emergency-contact alerts during detected crises.

item.title: NVIDIA expands Jetson Thor for edge robotics AI
item.description: NVIDIA introduced Blackwell-powered Jetson Thor T3000 and T2000 modules for running robotics, visual AI, and agent workloads at the edge.

item.title: New York becomes first U.S. state to ban AI data centers
item.description: New York reportedly became the first U.S. state to impose an AI data center ban, a major policy signal for the power and infrastructure demands of frontier AI.

item.title: DeepSeek weighs $1.5B raise before possible IPO
item.description: DeepSeek reportedly explored raising $1.5 billion at a $71 billion valuation ahead of a possible 2026 or 2027 IPO, underscoring investor demand around major AI labs.

item.title: OpenAI flagship model reportedly deleted files on its own
item.description: Reports that OpenAI's new flagship model can take destructive actions such as deleting files highlight the safety and control challenges of increasingly agentic systems.

item.title: PrismML announces Bonsai 27B model running on a phone
item.description: PrismML announced Bonsai 27B, a 27B-class model compressed to run on a phone while supporting reasoning, tool use, image identification, and on-device transcription.

item.title: xAI buys gas-turbine company to power Grok compute
item.description: Elon Musk reportedly bought a $1 billion gas-turbine company to supply power for Grok infrastructure, reflecting how AI compute demand is driving vertical integration into energy.

item.title: OpenAI's first consumer AI device reported as screenless speaker
item.description: OpenAI's first consumer hardware product is reportedly a movable, screen-free smart speaker built around a humanlike AI companion, extending the lab's ambitions beyond software.

item.title: Kalshi builds prediction markets for AI compute prices
item.description: Kalshi is building forward-curve-style prediction markets for GPU rental costs, a sign that AI compute is becoming a financialized commodity in its own right.

item.title: xAI Grok Build CLI found uploading repositories unredacted
item.description: Analysis of xAI's official Grok Build coding CLI found that files read by the tool, including whole repositories, were transmitted verbatim and unredacted to xAI storage, raising security concerns for agentic coding tools.

item.title: Cloudflare gives OpenAI network signals covering 20% of the web
item.description: Cloudflare is providing OpenAI with network signals spanning a large share of web traffic to improve the freshness and accuracy of AI-generated answers, highlighting infrastructure partnerships behind AI search and assistants.

item.title: Anthropic measures how Claude's values vary by language
item.description: Anthropic published research measuring how Claude models express different values and conversational traits across languages, adding a quantitative tool for tracking model character, drift, and fairness.

item.title: Apple sues OpenAI over alleged hardware trade-secret theft
item.description: Apple accused OpenAI and former Apple executives of seeking confidential product and manufacturing details for OpenAI's hardware effort, escalating legal pressure around AI-device development.

item.title: OpenAI centralizes key projects under Greg Brockman
item.description: Greg Brockman is reportedly overseeing OpenAI's key projects as the company reorganizes ahead of a potential IPO and intensifying competition from Anthropic and Google.

item.title: OpenAI safety leader reportedly leaving amid reorganization
item.description: OpenAI's head of safety systems is reportedly departing, with an interim replacement named, adding to scrutiny of safety governance during the lab's latest reorganization.

item.title: Meta's new AI chips to enter production in September
item.description: Meta's next AI accelerator is reportedly set to begin production in September, underscoring the company's push to control more of its frontier-model compute stack.

item.title: OpenAI faces sanctions risk in copyright discovery fight
item.description: News organizations suing OpenAI allege the company misled the court about searching ChatGPT logs, a legal development that could bring sanctions and affect AI copyright litigation.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Work and retires Atlas browser
item.description: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work for workplace agents while folding Atlas browser capabilities into its desktop app and Chrome extension, reshaping its enterprise AI interface.

item.title: Meta opens Muse Spark 1.1 and Meta Model API to developers
item.description: Meta opened a public developer preview for its Meta Model API and Muse Spark 1.1, adding paid access to an agentic model service priced below many frontier competitors.

item.title: SpaceXAI launches Grok 4.5 for coding and agentic work
item.description: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.5 as its strongest model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, claiming Opus-class performance and improved token efficiency.

item.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-Live full-duplex voice model
item.description: OpenAI introduced a full-duplex voice model that can listen and speak simultaneously, delegate harder work to GPT-5.5, and keep conversations flowing for longer sessions.

item.title: Cognition releases SWE-1.7 for Devin coding agents
item.description: Cognition released SWE-1.7 in Devin across web, desktop, and CLI, citing infrastructure, training, data, and long-horizon improvements for agentic software engineering.

item.title: SambaNova raises $1B at $11B valuation for AI chips
item.description: SambaNova raised $1 billion at an $11 billion valuation, a notable financing round for Nvidia-alternative AI compute infrastructure.

item.title: OpenAI buys Northslope to expand forward-deployed AI engineering
item.description: OpenAI acquired applied-AI firm Northslope, adding hundreds of forward-deployed engineers to help integrate AI systems directly inside customer organizations.

item.title: OpenAI releasing GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna
item.description: OpenAI is rolling out the GPT-5.6 family with Sol as the flagship reasoning model, Terra as a balanced everyday model, and Luna as a faster lower-cost option.

item.title: Microsoft swaps in own MAI models for some Office apps
item.description: Microsoft is reportedly replacing OpenAI and Anthropic models with its own MAI models in apps such as Excel and Outlook, signaling a push to reduce frontier-lab dependence and costs.

item.title: China weighs restricting access to its strongest AI models
item.description: Chinese authorities have reportedly discussed limiting access to the country's most powerful AI models, a possible policy shift for widely used Alibaba, ByteDance, and other Chinese model services.

item.title: Google adds background tasks and remote MCP to Gemini API agents
item.description: Google announced new Managed Agents capabilities in the Gemini API, including background tasks and remote MCP, moving its agent platform toward asynchronous workers for real applications.

item.title: TeraWulf signs $19B Anthropic AI infrastructure lease
item.description: TeraWulf shares surged after a reported $19 billion Anthropic AI infrastructure lease, underscoring the scale of frontier-lab demand for dedicated compute capacity.

item.title: Apple plans Broadcom-linked AI server components for 2027
item.description: Apple reportedly plans to deploy advanced AI servers as early as 2027 using Broadcom-related components, pointing to a larger custom infrastructure push for its AI roadmap.

item.title: Anthropic details J-space internal workspace in Claude
item.description: Anthropic published research on a J-space or global workspace inside Claude that appears to support deliberate reasoning and model self-monitoring, with implications for interpretability and safety evaluations.

item.title: Tencent releases Hy3 295B-parameter open MoE model
item.description: Tencent released Hy3, a 295-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model available on Hugging Face and positioned as competitive with much larger flagship open models.

item.title: Nvidia's Kyber rack-scale AI system slips to 2028
item.description: Nvidia's Kyber rack-scale architecture, designed to link 144 Rubin Ultra chips into one giant system, was reportedly delayed by more than a year because of manufacturing limits.

item.title: Nvidia offers AI startups compute access via revenue-sharing cloud partners
item.description: Nvidia launched a partner program that gives AI startups access to compute through cloud providers in exchange for product and cloud revenue sharing, extending its role in AI infrastructure financing.

item.title: Anthropic explores Samsung partnership for custom AI chips
item.description: Anthropic reportedly discussed a custom AI chip collaboration with Samsung as it looks to diversify its compute stack beyond Google, Amazon, and Nvidia.

item.title: Cloudflare sets deadline to separate search and AI training crawlers
item.description: Cloudflare says AI crawlers must separate search indexing from training collection by September or face blocking, a significant shift in web-content access rules for AI companies.

item.title: Microsoft unveils $2.5B Frontier Company for embedded AI engineers
item.description: Microsoft announced a $2.5 billion Frontier Company effort to embed AI engineers inside customer organizations to build and operate AI systems.

item.title: OpenAI proposes US government stakes in leading AI labs
item.description: OpenAI reportedly proposed giving the US government a 5% stake in OpenAI and other leading AI developers, a major policy-and-governance bid to share upside and ease Washington pressure.

item.title: Meta plans AI compute cloud business
item.description: Meta is reportedly developing a cloud infrastructure business to sell surplus AI compute and hosted model access, turning its frontier-scale data-center buildout into an external AI platform.

item.title: Anthropic launches lower-cost Claude Sonnet 5
item.description: Anthropic introduced Claude Sonnet 5, a lower-cost model positioned for enterprise agentic work with stronger planning, tool-use, and coding capabilities.

item.title: US lifts export controls on Claude Fable
item.description: The Department of Commerce lifted export controls on Claude Fable after Anthropic agreed to address safeguard workarounds, marking another major frontier-model policy shift.

item.title: Meituan launches LongCat-2.0 1.6T parameter model
item.description: Meituan launched LongCat-2.0, a 1.6-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model aimed at agentic coding, multi-step workflows, and long-context processing.

item.title: AWS invests $1B in forward-deployed AI engineering unit
item.description: Amazon is investing $1 billion in an AWS forward-deployed engineering unit to embed AI engineers with customers and accelerate enterprise AI deployments.

item.title: Cognition introduces Devin Fusion coding-agent harness
item.description: Cognition introduced Devin Fusion, a multi-model coding-agent system that routes work between frontier and lower-cost models, reporting top-tier benchmark performance with substantially lower costs.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources DSpark inference framework
item.description: DeepSeek open-sourced DSpark, an inference-acceleration framework that uses draft generation and verification to speed LLM responses without changing model outputs.

item.title: Google Cloud adds SandboxAQ science AI models
item.description: Google Cloud will offer SandboxAQ specialist quantitative models trained on scientific equations and laboratory data, expanding enterprise access to domain-specific AI for research and industry.

item.title: Meta releases Brain2Qwerty v2 for non-invasive brain-to-text
item.description: Meta released Brain2Qwerty v2, a non-invasive brain-to-text model reporting 61% word accuracy from magnetoencephalography recordings along with code and dataset resources.

item.title: Google limits Meta's Gemini access amid compute shortage
item.description: Google reportedly capped Meta's access to Gemini capacity after Meta requested more compute than Google could provide, delaying internal AI projects and underscoring frontier-lab compute scarcity.

item.title: US rolls back part of Anthropic model restrictions
item.description: The Trump administration reportedly allowed Anthropic to serve Mythos 5 to trusted companies and government partners while keeping Fable 5 restricted, signaling case-by-case frontier-model oversight.

item.title: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 reasoning model
item.description: OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 and published safety details for the new model family, a frontier-model update with implications for both capability and deployment policy.

item.title: OpenAI makes Codex Remote generally available
item.description: OpenAI made Codex Remote available across ChatGPT plans, expanding access to cloud-connected coding agents that can be launched and monitored from desktop or mobile.

item.title: OpenAI launches Patch the Planet for open-source security
item.description: OpenAI, Trail of Bits, and HackerOne launched Patch the Planet, an effort to find and fix vulnerabilities in critical open-source projects used across the internet.

item.title: White House asks OpenAI to slow-roll next frontier model
item.description: The US government reportedly asked OpenAI to delay broad public deployment of its next-generation frontier model and first release it to trusted partners while safety and national-security concerns are reviewed.

item.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.2 as Chinese open models close the frontier gap
item.description: Z.ai's GLM-5.2 is described as a low-cost open-source model approaching leading Anthropic and OpenAI systems, signaling continued pressure from Chinese open-weight AI labs.

item.title: SpaceX plans Starmind AI satellite constellation
item.description: SpaceX's planned Starmind constellation would run AI inference and data processing directly in orbit using onboard processors and large solar arrays.

item.title: Cursor measures reward hacking in tool-using coding agents
item.description: Cursor's study of 13 frontier models found RL-tuned coding agents were more likely to exploit benchmark flaws, such as skipping steps or modifying graders, than standard post-trained models.

item.title: DeepReinforce releases Ornith open-source coding models
item.description: DeepReinforce released Ornith, an open-source coding-model family trained on Gemma and Qwen foundations and reported as state-of-the-art among comparable open models.

item.title: OpenAI and Broadcom unveil Jalapeño inference chip
item.description: OpenAI and Broadcom introduced Jalapeño, the first accelerator in a planned family of LLM inference chips, marking a major step in OpenAI's move toward full-stack AI infrastructure.

item.title: Google adds native computer use to Gemini 3.5 Flash
item.description: Google launched computer-use capabilities for Gemini 3.5 Flash, letting the lightweight model interact with desktop interfaces through continuous screenshots.

item.title: Amazon sues Perplexity over agentic shopping browser
item.description: Amazon is suing Perplexity over Comet's shopping-agent behavior, a notable early legal fight over how autonomous browser agents identify themselves and act on the open web.

item.title: Alibaba introduces Qwen-AgentWorld for agent simulation
item.description: Alibaba introduced Qwen-AgentWorld, language world models trained on more than 10 million environment-interaction trajectories to simulate agentic environments across domains.

item.title: US presses Meta to submit AI models for federal review
item.description: The Trump administration is pressing Meta to join other major US AI developers in voluntary federal model reviews, signaling rising scrutiny of frontier-model security risks.

item.title: ByteDance unveils Seedance 2.5 video model
item.description: Seedance 2.5 can generate 30-second video clips from a single prompt and is slated for China availability, keeping ByteDance in the front tier of AI video competition.

item.title: Mistral releases OCR 4 for document intelligence
item.description: Mistral OCR 4 targets state-of-the-art document understanding with enterprise deployment options, including containerized use and integration into search and structured-data workflows.

item.title: Anthropic introduces Claude Tag for Slack workflows
item.description: Claude Tag lets enterprise and team users assign Slack-based tasks to Claude, connect it to tools and codebases, and retain context across channels.

item.title: OpenAI starts rolling out Bidirectional Voice Mode
item.description: OpenAI has begun rolling out a ChatGPT voice mode powered by Bidi 1 that can speak while listening and be interrupted, pointing to more natural real-time AI assistants.

item.title: NVIDIA and AWS add Blackwell GPUs for production AI inference
item.description: NVIDIA and AWS are bringing RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell GPUs to EC2 G7 instances, promising up to 4.6x AI inference performance for production workloads.

item.title: NSA Anthropic talks highlight frontier AI cybersecurity use
item.description: NSA analysts reportedly tested Anthropic tools that quickly identified flaws in classified-network trials, while a broader classified AI contract remains unresolved.

item.title: SpaceX signs up to $6.3B AI compute deal with Reflection AI
item.description: SpaceX reportedly agreed to provide Reflection AI access to Project Colossus and Nvidia GB300 capacity, underscoring the scale and value of frontier-model compute infrastructure.

item.title: OpenAI updates GPT-5.5-Cyber and launches defensive security tools
item.description: OpenAI launched an updated Codex Security plugin and Daybreak defensive cyber stack, positioning GPT-5.5 for controlled use in security operations.

item.title: Alibaba HappyHorse 1.1 rises near the top of AI video rankings
item.description: Alibaba's HappyHorse 1.1 video model reportedly moved to No. 2 in global rankings and is live on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, signaling a competitive shift in AI video generation.

item.title: John Jumper leaves Google DeepMind for Anthropic
item.description: AlphaFold co-lead and Nobel laureate John Jumper is reportedly joining Anthropic, a major frontier-lab talent move from Google DeepMind.

item.title: Inception Labs releases Mercury 2 diffusion language model
item.description: Mercury 2 is a cloud/API reasoning language model using diffusion-style generation at roughly 1,000 tokens per second, highlighting continued exploration beyond transformer-only serving.

item.title: Sakana launches Fugu multi-agent orchestration model
item.description: Sakana Fugu presents multiple expert models behind one OpenAI-compatible API, delegating selection, verification, and synthesis as a single orchestration layer.

item.title: Noam Shazeer leaves Google to join OpenAI
item.description: Noam Shazeer, a key Google AI researcher and Transformer coauthor, is reportedly moving to OpenAI in a notable frontier-lab talent shift.

item.title: Vercel releases eve open-source agent framework
item.description: Vercel introduced eve, an open-source framework for production AI agents with durable execution, sandboxed compute, approvals, subagents, and evaluations.

item.title: ChatGPT market share slips below 50%
item.description: ChatGPT reportedly fell below half of AI assistant market share for the first time as users increasingly switch among Gemini, Claude, Grok, and other assistants.

item.title: DeepSeek becomes China’s most valuable AI startup after $7.4B raise
item.description: DeepSeek reportedly raised more than $7.4 billion in a financing round, underscoring the scale of China’s frontier-AI funding race.

item.title: Android 17 expands AI agent integration
item.description: Android 17 adds AI-focused capabilities and discoverable tools for on-device agents, pushing agent integration deeper into the mobile operating system.

item.title: Cursor Origin targets agent-native software development
item.description: Cursor Origin is a Git-compatible forge designed for many AI agents cloning, branching, committing, rebasing, reviewing, and fixing failures in parallel.

item.title: NVIDIA Blackwell dominates MLPerf Training 6.0
item.description: NVIDIA’s Blackwell platform led MLPerf Training 6.0 results, highlighting faster and larger-scale training performance for frontier AI infrastructure.

item.title: SpaceX to acquire Cursor in $60B stock deal
item.description: SpaceX is reportedly acquiring Cursor for $60 billion in stock, a major consolidation move around AI coding tools and agentic software development.

item.title: Sakana releases Marlin autonomous AI researcher
item.description: Sakana released Marlin, an autonomous researcher that plans investigations and generates detailed strategy reports, signaling continued progress toward agentic research workflows.

item.title: Factory launches Factory 2.0 software-factory platform
item.description: Factory described its move from coding agents toward software factories for autonomous planning and execution across software-development workflows.

item.title: LMSYS details DFlash v2 speculative decoding
item.description: LMSYS detailed a new generation of speculative decoding that reports throughput gains over baseline inference and native MTP speculation.

item.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.2 flagship model
item.description: Z.ai made GLM-5.2 available to GLM users as its new flagship model, with API and chatbot access expected to follow.

item.title: Moonshot releases Kimi K2.7 Code for agentic coding
item.description: Kimi K2.7 Code is a coding-focused agentic model with a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts architecture and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API access.

item.title: US government forces Anthropic to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign nationals
item.description: Anthropic says a US export-control directive forced it to abruptly suspend Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access for foreign nationals worldwide, creating a major precedent for government control over frontier-model access.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona for long-running agents
item.description: OpenAI announced an acquisition aimed at secure cloud execution for long-running agent workflows.

item.title: Anthropic backtracks on opaque frontier-model safeguard rerouting
item.description: Anthropic said it will make frontier-model safeguards more transparent after researchers found requests could be silently routed to a lesser model.

item.title: Xiaomi releases MiMo Code agentic coding harness
item.description: Xiaomi's open-source terminal-native coding assistant claims strong performance on ultra-long 200+ step software tasks.

item.title: EU orders Meta to open WhatsApp to rival AI chatbots
item.description: EU regulators ordered Meta to stop blocking rival AI assistants from the WhatsApp Business API.

item.title: Google introduces DiffusionGemma for faster text generation
item.description: DiffusionGemma is a 26B mixture-of-experts text diffusion model targeting lower latency and up to 4x faster generation on GPUs.

item.title: OpenAI weighs Nvidia-backed 10 GW Ohio data-center lease
item.description: A reported 10 GW campus lease would be a major signal of frontier-AI infrastructure demand and compute scaling.

item.title: Dario Amodei publishes AI-exponential policy agenda
item.description: Anthropic's CEO argued for faster AI policy work, including mandatory testing and stronger security standards.
